verdict.rationale: Greenhouse ships several discrete AI-powered features that perform tasks on the user's behalf—Notetaker auto-records/transcribes and maps notes to scorecards, Voice AI conducts a full first-round interview, and Talent Matching auto-tiers applications—which is a form of task delegation to embedded AI. However, there is no evidence of a unified, general-purpose conversational AI assistant that a user can direct with arbitrary natural-language instructions across the product. Missing for 10: a chat/agent interface for open-ended task delegation, documentation of an assistant users can instruct freely, and independent hands-on confirmation of these AI features working as advertised.
